historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the final working drawings for the Bernal Field House addition, designed by Masten and Hurd.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for alterations and additions to the Bernal Heights field house to Antone Petersen & Sons at $34,385.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $227,000 renovation of the children's play area at Bernal Heights Playground, with a tot sand area and structures, several kinds of swings and safety matting for disabled access.
